svg.title: Five orders for the same five steps
svg.desc: Naive: sign, publish, tiles; a crash between publish and tiles forks. Tiles first: tiles, sign, publish; safe from crashes, but storage is the only record, so a rollback or a twin forks. Lock first: sign, lock, tiles, publish; a crash between lock and tiles leaves a locked checkpoint with no tiles, stuck. Sunlight: tiles, sign, lock, publish; recovers from every crash, but tiles beyond the lock get rewritten, which conditional writes refuse. Staged: stage tiles under a private name for this exact tree, sign, lock, copy, publish; recovery rolls the copy forward.

text.tspan: the lock is a compare-and-swap record of the last checkpoint ever signed for this log.
